title: Welcome to Feast Frenzy
body: A guest is walking in. Every guest takes a table and orders a few courses. Keep them cozy and well fed.

title: Fire up a station
body: Tap the visible Cook button on a kitchen station (or press 1-4) that matches an ordered course color to start cooking.

title: Carry the dish
body: When the dish is plated, tap it to pick it up and carry it to the floor.

title: Serve the course
body: Tap Serve on the guest who ordered it. Preferred dishes (their colored dots) pay double.

title: Fatten them up
body: A fully served guest pays up, leaves happy... and comes back hungrier. The pink pips under a guest show how plump they are getting.

title: Plump and ready
body: When the pips fill, a guest is ready for the Last Meal Lounge. Watch for the glow when they next visit.

title: The Last Meal Lounge
body: Tap VIP on a plump, seated guest to invite them into the Lounge for their final course.

title: The house specialty
body: The Lounge stocks your larder with premium meat. Spend it to attract richer clientele and craft recipes - richer guests mean rarer meat. That is the whole game.
